entities.summary: Puli Khumri, also written as Pul-i-Khumri or Pol-e Khomri, is a city in northern Afghanistan, serving as the capital of Baghlan Province. It is within the jurisdiction of Puli Khumri District and has an estimated population of 230,112 people. Maulvi Abdul Latif Mazlom is the current mayor of the city. His predecessor was Maulvi Mohammad Anwar Mustaqeem.
